evidence.quote: it is crucial that we maintain the ability of central banks to make monetary policy independently of short-term political influence.
I will outline the general case for central bank independence and review the evolution of the independence of the Federal Reserve and other major central banks.
I think there is a good case for granting the central bank independence in making quantitative easing decisions, just as with other monetary policies.

parsed.rationale: The speech is an institutional discussion of central bank independence, transparency and accountability, and it offers no view on the current outlook or the future policy path. Its emphasis on inflation-fighting credibility is general principle, not a policy signal, so the stance is neutral.
